note: Hand-authored `.SYNTHETIC.`-caveated fixtures for `GeminiProvider` (flow 183, T7 / AC2, AC5). NO live `GEMINI_API_KEY`/`GOOGLE_API_KEY` was available in this environment (see this flow's description.md 'Known, explicit deviation from the docpack' and acceptance-criteria.md AC2). Every fixture here was built from CURRENT vendor documentation researched live via WebSearch/WebFetch during this task (2026-08-20/21) against https://ai.google.dev/api/generate-content, https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/{thinking,generate-content/thinking,function-calling,troubleshooting}, and https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/streaming — NOT captured from a real API call, and NOT training-data recall. `captured: false` on every entry below, by construction (no key available), mirroring the honest-gap pattern `keryx-mcp-client`'s manifest used for its unreproducible fixtures.

provenance.method: Hand-authored from live-researched current Gemini generateContent/streamGenerateContent REST API documentation. Every wire-shape decision below cites the specific research finding that grounds it, not an assumption.
provenance.sseFramingConfirmed: streamGenerateContent?alt=sse returns text/event-stream where each `data: <json>` line (terminated by a blank line) IS one complete GenerateContentResponse object — no `event:` line, no fragmented JSON split across multiple data: lines. Confirmed via WebSearch across multiple independent sources (apiyi.com docs mirror, google-gemini/cookbook Streaming_REST notebook description, machinelearningplus tutorial) all describing the same single-complete-object-per-line shape. This means `AnthropicSSEParser` (a generic `data:`-line framer tolerant of an absent `event:` field) fits Gemini's framing UNCHANGED — no adaptation was needed, contrary to plan.md's open question on this point.
provenance.toolCallArgGranularityConfirmed: By default, functionCall.args arrives WHOLE in a single chunk — Gemini does NOT stream partial function-call arguments the way OpenAI/the compat engine's input_json_delta pattern does. Incremental argument streaming (toolConfig.functionCallingConfig.streamFunctionCallArguments -> partialArgs/willContinue, with jsonPath-addressed deltas) IS a real, documented feature but is (a) an explicit request-time opt-in this adapter does not enable, and (b) associated in research with newer/Gemini-3+ model support and the Interactions API's own streaming shape, not a default behavior of legacy generateContent. This REFINES plan.md's flagged uncertainty rather than leaving it open: tool_call_start is immediately followed by tool_call_end with the complete args JSON, no tool_call_delta.
provenance.reasoningMetadataConfirmed: generationConfig.thinkingConfig.{thinkingBudget, includeThoughts} is the confirmed request shape for the LEGACY generateContent API specifically (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/generate-content/thinking's REST curl example quotes `generationConfig: { thinkingConfig: { thinkingBudget: 1024 } }` verbatim), and a thought-summary content part carries a boolean `thought: true` field alongside `text` (same page, Python/Go code samples check `part.thought`/`part.Thought`). This CONFIRMS (not guesses) `reasoningMetadata: true`, refining plan.md's 'default false unless confirmed' caveat. IMPORTANT caveat found during research: a DIFFERENT, newer Interactions-API-only shape (`generation_config.thinking_level`/`thinking_summaries`, response `steps[].type:"thought"`) exists and is easy to confuse with the generateContent shape above — this adapter targets ONLY the generateContent shape (thinkingConfig/thinkingBudget/includeThoughts/thought:true), consistent with plan.md's architectural decision to target legacy generateContent, not Interactions.
provenance.errorEnvelopeConfirmed: Google's error envelope on generateContent/streamGenerateContent is {"error":{"code":<number, HTTP-status-like>,"message":<string>,"status":<RPC enum string>}} — confirmed via WebSearch across the Gemini CLI issue tracker, the Bid Manager API errors reference (same google.rpc.Code shape), and multiple troubleshooting-guide mirrors quoting the exact JSON. Confirmed status enum values used by this adapter's classifier: UNAUTHENTICATED (401), RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED (429), INVALID_ARGUMENT (400), UNAVAILABLE (5xx). Retry-After/RetryInfo on 429s: explicitly NOT documented anywhere found in research (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/troubleshooting only recommends client-side exponential backoff, no header/field named) — this adapter does not fabricate a retryAfterMs.
provenance.authHeaderConfirmed: x-goog-api-key header used as the primary/preferred auth form per this flow's plan.md instruction (query-param ?key= flagged unconfirmed-still-working in plan.md's own research and not independently re-verified in this task — the header form is the one implemented and fixtured).

text-tool-usage.sse.case: Clean streamed response: two text_delta chunks, then a functionCall part (whole args, one chunk) with finishReason:"STOP" and usageMetadata on the final chunk.
text-tool-usage.sse.caveat: Hand-authored from the researched wire shape above. Field values (token counts, tool name/args) are illustrative fixture data, not observed from a real call.

error-invalid-argument.json.case: 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT error envelope, used by gemini-provider.test.ts's HTTP error taxonomy suite.
error-invalid-argument.json.caveat: Hand-authored from the confirmed {code,message,status} envelope shape; message text is illustrative.

inline (in gemini-provider.test.ts).case: 401 UNAUTHENTICATED, 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, 503 UNAVAILABLE error envelopes; a thought:true reasoning-part chunk; a tool-result round trip (functionResponse as a role:"user" message, keyed by the linked assistant functionCall's id/name).
inline (in gemini-provider.test.ts).caveat: Built inline in the test file (not separate fixture files) for locality with the assertions they support. Same provenance as the file-based fixtures: hand-authored from the researched wire shapes documented above, not captured.

gaps: AC2 is explicitly NOT MET by this flow (see acceptance-criteria.md): no live GEMINI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY was available to verify these fixtures against a real streamGenerateContent call. Live verification remains an open follow-up.

The exact shape of usageMetadata's presence-per-chunk vs. final-chunk-only was not confirmed by research (sources described the final aggregate but did not state whether intermediate chunks also carry a partial usageMetadata) — the adapter defensively folds progressively-seen usageMetadata and emits usage_update once at the end, which is correct under either behavior, but this specific timing detail is unconfirmed.

Whether the ?key=<apiKey> query-param auth form still works was not re-verified in this task (plan.md already flagged it unconfirmed) — only the x-goog-api-key header form, which research confirms is current/documented, is implemented.

A context-overflow-specific error status/code distinct from plain INVALID_ARGUMENT (analogous to OpenAI's documented empty-message streaming bug) was not found in research for Gemini — this adapter classifies all 400s as invalid_request rather than guessing a context_overflow detection heuristic, per plan.md's documented-fallback guidance.

The dedicated {model}:countTokens endpoint is not wired by this adapter (tokenCounting: false) — confirmed to exist by prior flow research but wiring it was left as optional, out-of-scope-for-this-task per the T7 dispatch instructions.

No fixture exercises Gemini's inlineData/fileData vision content parts (vision: true is claimed on the strength of general documentation confirming base64 image support exists, per plan.md's capability matrix, but this adapter's stream()/toGeminiContents() do not yet build request-side inlineData parts from NormalizedMessage — vision capability is advertised at the descriptor level per the flow's capability-matrix instruction, but exercising it end-to-end was not in this task's scope).
